clue.text: Gets the dog and looks around

indicators.note: around tells us the word for looking wraps itself about the dog

parts.note: looks means sees
a cur is a dog, usually a mongrel

explanation.surface: Someone fetches the dog and glances about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gets' looks like the verb fetching the dog, but it is the definition, meaning obtains; 'around' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To secure something is to obtain it, a synonym of gets.

clue.text: The casual worker has to move fast!

definitions.meaning: one who scamps work does it carelessly and hastily
to dash or scurry along quickly

explanation.surface: A temp is told to hurry up.
explanation.definitionFit: To scamp a job is to skimp it, so a careless worker is one; and to scurry is the verb sense.

clue.text: Not decent maybe, but quite happy

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of the preceding words could be something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is indecent, perhaps, but very pleased about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Contented means satisfied, a synonym of quite happy.

clue.text: Military personnel accompanying the first lady magistrate

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
Eve was the first woman in Genesis

explanation.surface: Soldiers escort the original woman, who is a justice.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve was a medieval English local official with magisterial powers, a historical sense.

clue.text: Exemplary colours?

parts.note: flags carried as regimental colours share a name with the benchmarks an exemplary person sets

explanation.surface: A question about flags that set a fine example.
explanation.definitionFit: Regimental flags are called by this name, and so are the benchmarks of excellence one exemplifies.

clue.text: The last month the Left are to speak out

parts.note: December is the last month, abbreviated Dec

explanation.surface: Late in the year, left-wingers are going to voice their views.
explanation.definitionFit: To declare is to state openly, a synonym of speak out.

clue.text: Hesitate to make modest cut

indicators.note: cut means the word for modest is docked of its final letter

parts.note: demure means modest and reserved

explanation.surface: Someone pauses before making a small reduction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' removes the last E of DEMURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise objections or hold back, a synonym of hesitate.

clue.text: Firm with a woman in order to beat a problem

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
a nun is a woman in a religious order
to drum is to beat

explanation.surface: A company and a woman team up to overcome a difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' is not an anagram signal here: it means a religious order.
explanation.definitionFit: A conundrum is a puzzling question, a synonym of a problem.

clue.text: Behind a measure the sovereign's taken

parts.note: FT is the abbreviation for foot or feet, a measure
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen; the 's stands for has

explanation.surface: Someone lags behind with the monarch's chosen measurement.
explanation.definitionFit: After means following or later, as behind does in time or place.

clue.text: Pledge to provide a home with listening equipment initially

indicators.note: initially says the hearing organ goes at the start, before the home

parts.note: the ear is the body's equipment for listening
a nest is a bird's home

explanation.surface: A guarantee to supply a house fitted with hearing devices first.
explanation.definitionFit: An earnest is money paid as a pledge or token of good faith, a dated sense.

clue.text: Inane make-up for a girl

indicators.note: make-up means the letters are made up into a new form

explanation.surface: Silly cosmetics for a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Annie is a girl's name, an example of the definition.

clue.text: Times in a cathedral for carpeting

indicators.note: in places the multiplication sign inside the phrase for a cathedral

parts.note: a minster is a large church or cathedral, as at York
X is the multiplication sign, read as times

explanation.surface: Moments spent in a cathedral to buy floor coverings.
explanation.definitionFit: Axminster is a type of woven carpet named after a Devon town, an example of carpeting.

clue.text: A poser before a nurse

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before
a tender is one who tends, as a nurse does

explanation.surface: A model posing ahead of a nurse.
explanation.definitionFit: A pretender is one who poses as something, or claims a throne falsely.

clue.text: Sauce bottle

definitions.meaning: British slang for cheek or impudence

explanation.definitionFit: Nerve means cheek, matching sauce, and courage, matching bottle in British slang.

clue.text: A relation calling for a certain amount of cooperation

indicators.note: a certain amount of means only some letters within the word are taken

explanation.surface: A family member calling for some collaboration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a certain amount of' takes a run of letters from inside cooperation; 'A relation' looks like a relative but is a mathematical relation.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio is a quantitative relation between two amounts.

clue.text: To throw money around carelessly proves to have a limit

indicators.note: carelessly suggests the letters of proves are thrown about anyhow

parts.note: an end is a limit

explanation.surface: Wasting money carelessly shows a person has a ceiling.
explanation.definitionFit: To overspend is to spend too much, the same as throwing money around.

clue.text: Bread scattered among the leftovers for a bird

indicators.note: among puts the rearranged bread inside the word for leftovers

parts.note: the rest is what is left over

indicators.note: scattered tells us the letters of bread are dispersed

explanation.surface: Crumbs thrown among the scraps for a garden bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bread scattered' paints crumbs thrown for birds, but 'scattered' is the anagram signal giving DBREA, and 'among' the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Redbreast is a name for the robin, an example of a bird.

clue.text: Track supervision

definitions.meaning: management or guidance, as of a film or orchestra

explanation.definitionFit: Direction means a course taken, matching track, and guidance, matching supervision.

clue.text: Refuge making no charge — a questionable arrangement

indicators.note: a questionable arrangement means the letters before it are set in a dubious new order

explanation.surface: A free shelter offered on dodgy terms.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchorage is a place where ships shelter, a refuge.

clue.text: Writing about some furniture restorer

parts.note: in letter writing re means about or concerning
a dresser is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: An essay on furniture renovation.
explanation.definitionFit: A redresser is one who puts right or restores, a rare noun from redress.

clue.text: For coppers in a small band, it's rough

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the word for a band

parts.note: a ring is a circular band
P stands for pence, copper coins

explanation.surface: For police officers in a little group, things are tough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A, S and P inside RING; 'coppers' looks like police but means pennies.
explanation.definitionFit: Rasping means harsh and grating, a synonym of rough.

clue.text: Many love tea and coffee

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, many
love is zero in tennis, O
cha is British slang for tea

explanation.surface: Lots of people adore both hot drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Mocha is a fine coffee, originally shipped from the Yemeni port of that name.

clue.text: A permit carried by the runner

indicators.note: carried by means the word for permit is held inside the next word

parts.note: to let is to permit

explanation.surface: A licence is held by the racer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' reads as someone carrying a message, but it is the definition; 'carried by' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An athlete may be a runner, so the definition is an example.

clue.text: Blows on the feet

explanation.definitionFit: Socks are punches in slang, and also the garments worn on feet.

clue.text: Get Burlington House a good oil-supplier

parts.note: to cop is to get or catch, informally
Burlington House in London is home of the Royal Academy, RA

explanation.surface: Fetch a fine oil painter from the London gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: Copra is dried coconut kernel from which coconut oil is pressed.

clue.text: Dismiss ministers as a sign of contrition

parts.note: to sack is to dismiss from a job
the cloth is the clergy collectively

explanation.surface: A leader fires the cabinet to show penitence.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing sackcloth and ashes is the traditional sign of penitence, so the cloth stands for contrition.

clue.text: Drags up the turf

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: draws means drags or pulls

explanation.surface: Someone pulls up the grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Sward is grassy ground, a synonym of turf.

clue.text: Work in the Channel Islands producing plants

indicators.note: in places the word for work inside the islands abbreviation

parts.note: CI is the abbreviation for the Channel Islands
to act is to work or function

explanation.surface: A job in Jersey or Guernsey growing greenery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'producing' is only a link word; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Cacti are spiny desert plants, so they are an example.

clue.text: Entertainment managers find the really naughty child is rare, surprisingly

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters of is rare turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Showbiz bosses find a truly badly behaved child is uncommon.
explanation.definitionFit: Impresarios organise and finance concerts and shows, being entertainment managers.

clue.text: Petition the Conservative leader to go on

indicators.note: leader takes the opening letter of Conservative

parts.note: to rave is to go on at length enthusiastically

explanation.surface: Asking the Tory chief to continue.
explanation.definitionFit: To crave is to beg earnestly, an old sense matching petition as a verb.

clue.text: Excellent publicity arranged by one of the family

parts.note: grand means excellent
an ad, short for advertisement, is publicity

explanation.surface: A relative organised some great advertising.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandfather, informally called this, is a family member.

clue.text: Training a vine, note, is simplicity itself

indicators.note: training a plant forms it into a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Teaching a grapevine is a simple matter, says the gardener.
explanation.definitionFit: Naivety is artless innocence, simplicity in its purest form.
